<action type="say">
Here’s how to move it in Google Calendar on desktop, keeping the same time and location:

Option A – drag it:
1) Go to calendar.google.com on your computer.
2) In the left sidebar, make sure the correct calendar is visible (the one with “Teacher Meeting”).
3) In the week or month view, find “Teacher Meeting” on Friday 12/12/2025.
4) Click and hold the event, then drag it to Saturday 12/13/2025.
5) Release the mouse. If Google asks, confirm sending updates to guests.

Option B – edit the event:
1) Click “Teacher Meeting” on Friday 12/12/2025.
2) In the popup, click the pencil icon (Edit event).
3) In the date field, change the date from 12/12/2025 to 12/13/2025.
4) Make sure the start and end times and the location stayed the same.
5) Click “Save.”
6) When prompted, choose “Send” to notify guests.

If you’d like a short note in the description to explain the change, you can add something like:
“Rescheduled from Friday 12/12/2025 to Saturday 12/13/2025, same time and location.”</action>
